description: Estimate 2026 tax on 1099 / self-employment income: self-employment tax (Social Security and Medicare, with its full breakdown), federal income tax, optional flat state tax, the percent of each payment to set aside, and the quarterly payment. Same math as the auracalcs.com 1099 tax and self-employment tax calculators. Returns a link to the page, sources, the date checked, and a disclaimer. Estimate only.

applyQbiDeduction.description: Apply the 20% qualified business income deduction. Defaults to true, like the website.

businessExpenses.description: Deductible business expenses for the year. Defaults to 0.

filingStatus.description: single or married (filing jointly). Defaults to single.

grossIncome.description: Total 1099 / self-employment income for 2026, before expenses.

healthInsurancePremiums.description: Self-employed health insurance premiums. Defaults to 0.

retirementContributions.description: SEP IRA or solo 401(k) contributions. Defaults to 0.

stateTaxRate.description: Flat state income tax rate in percent, applied to AGI. Use 0 for no-income-tax states. Defaults to 0, so state tax is left out unless given.

w2Wages.description: Other W-2 wages this year. They use up the Social Security wage base first. Defaults to 0.

name: calculate_1099_tax
title: Estimate 2026 1099 and self-employment tax
